entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Welcome, sir. May I see your[n]membership card?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: One of our targets, the powerful[n]politician, should be at the restaurant.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Very well. Exercising caution isn't a bad[n]idea at all.

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Thank you for displaying your proof of[n]membership, sir. Please head on inside.

entries.speaker: Waiter
entries.en: Seats marked with a blue flower are[n]reserved for special guests. Please[n]refrain from sitting there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A reserved seat is special information.[n]That may lead us to the politician we're[n]looking for.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That possibility didn't even cross your[n]mind!? Ugh. Anyway, let's head in and[n]find a seat.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, things're pretty damn luxurious in[n]here. Even the food looks super good!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Try not to get too excited, okay? You're[n]embarrassing us...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Who should we target next? We still[n]need four more letters.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: According to the map, the elevator[n]ahead will take us to the pool deck.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... If our intel is correct, there should[n]be a womanizing "former noble" there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Womanizing, huh...? I am so not up[n]for this...
